author: Ayeda Okambawa
name: enfuseAS
description: Enfuse Advanced: an export/storage module that focus-stacks or HDR-blends a group of images, fixing the frame ordering so they stack correctly.
description-extensive: A more capable version of the Enfuse blending tool, added as an export option, that merges a group of photos into one focus-stacked or HDR image and corrects a frame-ordering problem so the shots combine in the right sequence. It requires the enfuse, align_image_stack and exiftool tools.
